parametrized_description: A firm makes NumParts types of spare automobile parts using NumMachines machines. Producing one unit of part k on machine s requires Time worker-hours. Each machine s has Capacity worker-hours available. Each part k yields Profit per unit. Determine how many of each part to produce to maximize total profit.

NumParts.description: Number of types of spare parts

Time.description: Worker-hours required to produce one unit of part k on machine s

Profit.description: Profit from producing one unit of part k

Capacity.description: Available worker-hours capacity of machine s

Quantity.description: Number of units of part k to produce

constraints.description: Total worker-hours used on each machine must not exceed its capacity.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs((quicksum(Time[k][s] * Quantity[k] for k in range(NumParts)) <= Capacity[s] for s in range(NumMachines)), name="MachineCapacity")
model.addConstrs((Quantity[k] >= 0 for k in range(NumParts)), name="NonNeg")

objective.description: Maximize total profit from all parts produced.

code.gurobipy: model.setObjective(quicksum(Profit[k] * Quantity[k] for k in range(NumParts)), GRB.MAXIMIZE)
